purpose: Canonical full-replay isolation of an unmasked CPU camera veto applied only to mode 20 textureless stationary fallback/state disocclusion.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 23 preserved mode 20 risk/prime lifetimes, stable/current authority, hold authorization, and event-camera semantics; only the textureless fallback/state-disocclusion path received the unmasked camera veto.
interpretation: Mode 23 is effectively identical to mode 20 on the decisive failures. The fallback-only camera veto did not reduce extreme-pan error and did not change weak-flash protection, disproving the hypothesis that the mode-20 pan regression was primarily caused by textureless state persistence. The next probe should isolate mode 21 display-authority camera vetoes rather than memory state.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
